evidence.title: IconSax - 5904 Open source free SVG icons

name: IconSax
summary: Searchable library of 5,904 free SVG icons in 32 categories, with adjustable stroke, size and color and copy-to-clipboard.
description: IconSax is a browser for 5,904 open source SVG icons organised in 32 categories (Arrow, Business, Crypto-Company, Design-Tools, Programing, Weather and more). Icons can be searched, their stroke, size and color changed live, and each copied to the clipboard as SVG; no attribution is required and use is free for commercial projects.
contains: 32 categories, e.g. Arrow 390, Essetional 600, Crypto-Company 511, Video-Audio-Image 486, Design-Tools 323
no attribution required, commercial use allowed
